name: @snow-the/dsh-search
description: Universal search toolkit for DeepSeek Harness: unified web search provider (Bing/DDG/SearXNG/Exa/Tavily with fallback chain + cache), page fetch, GitHub search, vector corpus, deep-web probe + local codebase semantic search (search_code).

scripts.test: node --import ./test/register-stubs.mjs --test test/smoke.mjs test/offtopic.test.mjs test/arxiv.test.mjs test/openalex.test.mjs test/github-quota.test.mjs test/core.test.mjs test/hubs.test.mjs test/opensources.test.mjs
scripts.pretest: esbuild src/query.ts src/github.ts src/server.ts src/websearch.ts src/arxiv.ts src/openalex.ts src/core.ts src/hubs.ts src/opensources.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outdir=.test-build --packages=external --external:@deepseek-ai/* --log-level=warning
